observations: Beach view shows separated cliffs, tent, canoe, animal campers, transparent shallow water, visible fish and coral.
Caravan camera shows three camels, patterned baggage, feeding troughs and striped shelter.
Oasis foreground palms were thinned so pool, fish, bridge and raised pavilion remain visible.
Day, pink sunset clouds, and starry night with warm campfire rendered.
All five planet choices and the enter button fit the reviewed portrait and landscape selector sizes.
Camera controls scroll horizontally on narrow screens; landscape tools can be expanded from the top bar.
